reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Virginia
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Whether "personal service to a suitable person other than the defendant and mail"
              is a PRIMARY method of service for eviction actions, where "primary" means a
              method that must be attempted before a secondary method is permitted.
*/

/* =========================================================
   SCENARIO FACTS (question's factual statement)
   ========================================================= */

scenario_state(virginia).
scenario_focus_year(2021).
scenario_action(eviction).  % eviction action (e.g., unlawful detainer)

% The questioned method: "personal service to a suitable person other than the defendant AND mail".
% We encode it as a single composite method the question is asking about.
scenario_queried_method(substituted_service_to_suitable_person_and_mail).

/* Succeeds when the factual scenario is fully represented. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(virginia),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_action(eviction),
    scenario_queried_method(substituted_service_to_suitable_person_and_mail).

/* =========================================================
   STATUTE TRANSLATION: VA Code  8.01-296 (2021)
   ========================================================= */

% -- Applicability --
% VA Code  8.01-296 (2021): Applies to civil proceedings where no particular mode of service is prescribed.
% We treat eviction actions as civil proceedings for this encoding.
statute_va_8_01_296_applies(virginia, 2021, eviction).

/* -- Enumerated methods of service for natural persons per  8.01-296 (2021) -- */
statute_va_8_01_296_service_method(personal_delivery_to_party).
statute_va_8_01_296_service_method(substituted_service_family_member_16_plus_at_abode).
statute_va_8_01_296_service_method(posting_at_abode_plus_mailing).
statute_va_8_01_296_service_method(order_of_publication).

/* -- Method component descriptions (helps match the question to a statutory method) -- */

%  8.01-296(1): Delivering a copy to the party in person.
statute_va_8_01_296_method_components(personal_delivery_to_party,
    [deliver_copy_to_party_in_person]).

%  8.01-296(2)(a): If party not found at usual place of abode, deliver copy and give info of purport
% to a family member (not a temporary sojourner/guest) age 16+ found there.
% NOTE: This subdivision does NOT add any mailing requirement.
statute_va_8_01_296_method_components(substituted_service_family_member_16_plus_at_abode,
    [deliver_copy_at_abode_to_family_member_16_plus,
     give_information_of_purport]).

%  8.01-296(2)(b): If service cannot be effected under (2)(a), then posting at door,
% PROVIDED that a copy is mailed (with later certificate of mailing).
statute_va_8_01_296_method_components(posting_at_abode_plus_mailing,
    [post_copy_at_main_entrance_of_abode,
     mail_copy_to_party,
     file_certificate_of_mailing]).

%  8.01-296(3): If service cannot be effected under (1) and (2), then order of publication.
statute_va_8_01_296_method_components(order_of_publication,
    [order_of_publication]).

/* -- Sequencing / prerequisites directly from the statute -- */

%  8.01-296(2)(b): Posting+mailing permitted only if (2)(a) cannot be effected.
statute_va_8_01_296_prerequisite(posting_at_abode_plus_mailing,
    substituted_service_family_member_16_plus_at_abode).

%  8.01-296(3): Publication permitted only if service cannot be effected under (1) and (2).
% Here, (2) includes both (2)(a) and (2)(b), so treat both as prerequisites.
statute_va_8_01_296_prerequisite(order_of_publication, personal_delivery_to_party).
statute_va_8_01_296_prerequisite(order_of_publication, substituted_service_family_member_16_plus_at_abode).
statute_va_8_01_296_prerequisite(order_of_publication, posting_at_abode_plus_mailing).

/* =========================================================
   HELPERS: "Primary method" concept from the question
   ========================================================= */

% Primary methods of service (per question definition):
% A method is "primary" if it must be attempted before some other (secondary) method is permitted.
legal_primary_service_method(State, Year, Action, Method) :-
    statute_va_8_01_296_applies(State, Year, Action),
    statute_va_8_01_296_service_method(Method),
    statute_va_8_01_296_prerequisite(_Secondary, Method).

/* Determine whether the scenario's queried method is a "primary method" under the statute. */
scenario_queried_method_is_primary :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_action(Action),
    scenario_queried_method(Queried),
    legal_primary_service_method(State, Year, Action, Queried).

/* =========================================================
   ANSWER
   ========================================================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_queried_method_is_primary,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    \+ scenario_queried_method_is_primary,
    !.

/* =========================================================
   MAIN ENTRYPOINT (required)
   ========================================================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Primary methods of service are defined as those methods that must be attempted before a secondary method is permitted. Is personal service to a suitable person other than the defendant and mail a primary method of service for eviction actions?
